limitations: The result is conditional on the caller's source-binding and phase-monotonicity evidence.
It covers only the common saved Z tube carried by the q=1 rows; it is not arbitrary-Z coverage.
Formal exp(source-log) factors are not materialized and no sector midpoint is selected.
The raw N=1 tail is an omitted-word majorant, not a signed field value.
No core-extension identity is used as a collar identity.

caller_premises_retained: eta support is the saved [0,3/4] source support

source_binding_evidence.analysis_checks_not_function_values: signed local collar/C_inner are explicitly not evaluated and signed point is false
source_binding_evidence.core_extension_not_used_as_collar: old core polynomial and old point values are explicitly excluded
source_binding_evidence.ordinary_Z_rows_same_source: ordinary_Z_orders == [0, 1] on selected enclosure and source family
source_binding_evidence.raw_vector_tail_dominates_each_field: saved coupled_source pin plus coupled preconditioned-tail AST broadcasts one norm error to every FIELDS component
source_binding_evidence.same_saved_Z_tube: q=1 selected_Z_interval equals the injected enclosure-level selected_Z_interval

zero_after_cutoff_scope.pressure_reason: The leaf is called only for F1 and Uz1; the cutoff measure is not a signed pressure or m15 value.
